text: The good news is that there are only seven letters in the musical alphabet. In this program we will be working with the key of C because it is the key with no flats or sharps. This means we will only be working with the white piano keys. These are the chords of the C scale. When you know these six chords the number of songs you can play is absolutely endless. That's the C chord. E minor, E minor, F major, G major, A minor. With the left hand. Practice those every day. When you get both hands down and you are comfortable with your hand position do them at the same time. [BLANK_AUDIO]
